digest.component_or_area: git history-strip operational script and dry-run harness
propositions: Build a committed one-time script that strips large paths from git history using stock plumbing (fast-export piped through a filter into fast-import) instead of git-filter-repo, so empty commits and DAG topology are preserved.
The script must strip both .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes, since the latter's history retains ~33 MB.
The re-add file set must be derived dynamically via ls-tree rather than hardcoded, because A2-1 adds get_rotation.json making it four files at window time.
The stream filter must be data<n>-length-aware to avoid corrupting commit messages that begin with M or D.
The script must refuse to run in a blob:none partial clone with a clear message, since fast-import fails with blob not found there.
The dry-run harness asserts commit/merge counts unchanged, new tip tree equals old tip tree, pack size drops to <=15% of original, and pushes only with --force-with-lease after all assertions pass.
